reason: I can already vent to free ChatGPT or Claude late at night, so I see no reason to pay a recurring subscription. Without established Reddit threads or app store reviews proving it's meaningfully better, I'm definitely not entering my credit card.
objection: Free general AI tools already provide conversational venting without a subscription, and there is no independent user consensus proving this offers anything superior.
would_change_my_mind: An active Reddit consensus and verified reviews showing the DBT exercises provide real clinical value far beyond what free Claude or ChatGPT can do.
